origin.description: Random points in a rectangle with a minimum separation. The check is a predicate, not the points.
origin.usage: poisson2disk(n, a = 1, b = 1, m = 10, info = TRUE)

arguments.name: m
arguments.text: Candidates tried around each accepted point.

origin.details: Eight points in the unit square. The check is the row count, two columns, and that every coordinate lies in (0, 1).
origin.value: Random points in a rectangle with a minimum separation. The check is a predicate, not the points.
origin.example: local({p <- poisson2disk(8, a=1, b=1, m=6, info=FALSE); c(nrow(p), ncol(p), as.numeric(all(p[,1] > 0 & p[,1] < 1 & p[,2] > 0 & p[,2] < 1)))})
